headline: Government Expects to Approve Housing Decree on Tuesday, but Without Expropriations
summary: The Spanish government expects to approve a housing decree on Tuesday without expropriation measures. Minister Bolaños says he can present powerful measures that Congress will approve, as pressure from partners grows.
why: Housing policy affects real estate prices, rental markets and construction activity, and government measures can shape investor sentiment in Spain's property sector.
